blocks.text: O'zbek tilida kelajak haqida ko'pincha hozirgi zamon shakli bilan gapiramiz: «Ertaga Samarqandga **ketyapman**», «Shanba kuni to'yga **boramiz**», «Poyezd soat yettida **jo'naydi**». Ingliz tilida ham shunday: kelajakdagi ishlar uchun har doim will kerak emas. Agar reja **oldindan kelishilgan** bo'lsa — **Present Continuous** (I**'m meeting** Aziz tomorrow), agar gap **jadval yoki dastur** haqida bo'lsa — **Present Simple** (The train **leaves** at 7.30). Bu darsda shu ikki holatni o'rganamiz.

items.text: **I'm meeting** my old teacher at six.
We**'re flying** to London on Monday.

blocks.text: Present Continuous (→ 3–4-darslar) kelajak uchun ishlatilganda reja **allaqachon tuzilgan**: chipta olingan, uchrashuv belgilangan, kimdir taklif qilingan, shifokorga yozilgan. Bunday rejani odatda kundalikka yozib qo'yasiz. Shakl o'zgarmaydi: am / is / are + `-ing`, inkor — **not**, so'roq — be egadan oldin. Ko'pincha `go` va `come` fe'llari bilan: I**'m going** to Bukhara on Friday, Are you **coming** to the party?

Present Continuous hozirgi payt haqida ham, kelajak haqida ham bo'lgani uchun, kelajak ma'nosini **vaqt so'zi** yoki vaziyat ko'rsatadi. Vaqt so'zi bo'lmasa — hozir: Dilnoza **is working** — hozir ishlayapti. tomorrow, on Friday kabi so'z bo'lsa — reja.

rows: dam olish kunlari / shu dam olish kunlari
next week / next month / next year

items.text: Dilnoza **is working** in the garden tomorrow.

blocks.text: Poyezd, avtobus, samolyot jadvali, kino va konsert boshlanishi, dars va kurslar, do'kon va muzeylarning ish vaqti — bular odamning xohishiga bog'liq emas, ular rasmiy jadvalda yozilgan. Bunday kelajak uchun **Present Simple** ishlatiladi: The film **starts** at 8.15. What time **does** the bank **open**? O'zbekchada ham xuddi shunday «-adi» shakli: «Film soat 8:15 da **boshlanadi**». Lekin shaxsiy rejalar uchun Present Simple ishlatilmaydi: «I meet my friend tomorrow» emas — **I'm meeting** my friend tomorrow.

rows: the train, the film, the shop, the course ...
We**'re meeting** at the cinema at eight.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I meet my friends tonight.» → **I'm meeting my friends tonight.** (shaxsiy reja — Present Continuous); «Tomorrow I working.» → **Tomorrow I'm working.** (am tushib qolmaydi); «What do you do tomorrow?» → **What are you doing tomorrow?** (What do you do? — «kasbingiz nima?»); «The train is leaving at 6.15 every day.» → **The train leaves at 6.15 every day.** (doimiy jadval); kelishilgan reja uchun «I will meet him at five» o'rniga ham **I'm meeting him at five** tabiiyroq.
Eslab qolish: **kundalikka** (diary) yozilgan reja → Present Continuous (I'm seeing the dentist on Monday). **Jadvalga** yoki afishaga yozilgan vaqt → Present Simple (The museum opens at ten).

O'zbekcha shakllar inglizchaga bir xil o'tmaydi. «Ertaga ketyapman / ketaman» — reja kelishilgan bo'lsa, **I'm leaving tomorrow** (shu dars). «Ketmoqchiman» — niyat, **I'm going to leave** (→ 26-dars). «Mayli, men olib kelaman» — hozir qabul qilingan qaror yoki va'da, **I'll bring it** (→ 27–28-darslar).

rows: I**'m flying** to Istanbul on Sunday.

examples.title: Arrangements: **I'm meeting** ... tomorrow
examples.description: Oldindan kelishilgan reja: am / is / are + `-ing` + kelajak vaqti (tomorrow, on Friday, next week). O'zbekchada: «uchrashaman», «kelishyapti», «boshlayapti».

sentences.text: **I'm meeting** Aziz for lunch tomorrow at one o'clock.
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat birda Aziz bilan tushlikda **uchrashaman**.

sentences.text: Emma **is flying** to Tashkent on Saturday — she's got her ticket.
sentences.translation: Emma shanba kuni Toshkentga **uchadi** — chiptasini olib qo'ygan.

sentences.text: We**'re having** a small party next Friday — are you free?
sentences.translation: Kelasi juma kuni kichik ziyofat **qilyapmiz** — bo'shmisiz?

sentences.text: My parents **are coming** to visit us at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari ota-onam bizni ko'rgani **kelishyapti**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is starting** his new job on the first of March.
sentences.translation: Bekzod 1-martdan yangi ishini **boshlayapti**.

sentences.text: Tonight Sarah **is cooking** dinner for her new neighbours.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun Sara yangi qo'shnilari uchun kechki ovqat **tayyorlaydi**.

sentences.text: **I'm seeing** the dentist on Thursday morning.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni ertalab tish shifokoriga **boraman**.

sentences.text: Next month Madina and Bekzod **are getting** married in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy Madina va Bekzod Samarqandda **turmush qurishyapti**.

sentences.text: The day after tomorrow our class **is visiting** the museum in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Indinga sinfimiz Buxorodagi muzeyga **boradi**.

sentences.text: James **is moving** to Manchester in June, and his company **is paying** for everything.
sentences.translation: Jeyms iyunda Manchesterga **ko'chib o'tyapti**, barcha xarajatni kompaniyasi **to'laydi**.

examples.title: Negative: **I'm not working** tomorrow
examples.description: Inkor reja: am / is / are + **not** + `-ing`. Ko'pincha boshqa reja bilan yonma-yon: We **aren't going** away — we**'re staying** at home.

sentences.text: **I'm not working** tomorrow — it's a holiday.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **ishlamayman** — bayram.

sentences.text: We **aren't going** away this summer; we**'re staying** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz hech qayerga **ketmayapmiz**, Toshkentda **qolamiz**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **isn't coming** to the meeting because she's ill.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kasal bo'lgani uchun majlisga **kelmaydi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I**'m not having** dinner with you tonight — I**'m meeting** a client.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bugun kechqurun siz bilan **ovqatlanmayman** — mijoz bilan **uchrashuvim bor**.

sentences.text: My brother **isn't driving** to Bukhara; he**'s taking** the train.
sentences.translation: Akam Buxoroga mashinada **bormayapti**, poyezdda **ketyapti**.

sentences.text: Tom and Sarah **aren't flying** to Spain on Monday — their flight was cancelled.
sentences.translation: Tom va Sara dushanba kuni Ispaniyaga **uchishmayapti** — reyslari bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: We **aren't having** a lesson on Wednesday — the teacher is at a conference.
sentences.translation: Chorshanba kuni darsimiz **bo'lmaydi** — o'qituvchi konferensiyada.

sentences.text: Aziz **isn't playing** in tomorrow's match — he hurt his leg yesterday.
sentences.translation: Aziz ertangi o'yinda **o'ynamaydi** — kecha oyog'ini lat yedirdi.

sentences.text: **I'm not coming** home for dinner tonight — I**'m working** late.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki ovqatga uyga **kelmayman** — kechgacha **ishlayman**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **aren't selling** their house after all; they**'re building** a second floor next year.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz baribir uylarini **sotishmayapti**, kelasi yili ikkinchi qavat **qurishadi**.

examples.title: Questions: **What are you doing** at the weekend?
examples.description: Birovning rejasini so'rash: **Are** you **doing** anything ...? What **are** you **doing** ...? Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

sentences.text: What **are** you **doing** this evening? — Nothing special.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun nima **qilyapsiz**? — Alohida hech narsa.

sentences.text: **Are** you **coming** to Madina's wedding on Sunday? — Yes, I am.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni Madinaning to'yiga **kelyapsizmi**? — Ha, kelaman.

sentences.text: When **are** your cousins **arriving** from Leeds?
sentences.translation: Amakivachchalaringiz Lidsdan qachon **kelishyapti**?

sentences.text: **Is** Bekzod **playing** football with us tomorrow? — No, he isn't.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ertaga biz bilan futbol **o'ynaydimi**? — Yo'q, o'ynamaydi.

sentences.text: Where **are** you **going** for your holiday this year? — To Turkey.
sentences.translation: Bu yil ta'tilga qayerga **ketyapsiz**? — Turkiyaga.

sentences.text: What time **is** the plumber **coming** on Monday?
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni chilangar soat nechada **keladi**?

sentences.text: **Are** you **doing** anything on Saturday night? — No, why?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni kechqurun biror **ishingiz bormi**? — Yo'q, nimaydi?

sentences.text: How **are** you **getting** to the airport — by taxi or by bus?
sentences.translation: Aeroportga qanday **borasiz** — taksidami yoki avtobusdami?

sentences.text: Which hotel **are** they **staying** at in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Ular Samarqandda qaysi mehmonxonada **turishadi**?

sentences.text: Why **is** Sarah **leaving** so early tomorrow? — She**'s catching** the 6.30 train.
sentences.translation: Sara ertaga nega bunchalik erta **ketyapti**? — U 6:30 dagi poyezdga **chiqadi**.

examples.title: Now or future? **is sleeping** now / tonight
examples.description: Present Continuous ham hozir, ham kelajak haqida: farqni vaqt so'zi yoki vaziyat ko'rsatadi. Vaqt so'zi bo'lmasa — hozir; tonight, on Saturday bo'lsa — reja.

sentences.text: Shh! The baby **is sleeping** right now.
sentences.translation: Jim! Chaqaloq hozir **uxlayapti**.

sentences.text: Tonight the baby **is sleeping** at her grandmother's.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi chaqaloq buvisinikida **uxlaydi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is playing** tennis now — he's on the court.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hozir tennis **o'ynayapti** — u kortda.

sentences.text: On Saturday Bekzod **is playing** tennis with his boss.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni Bekzod boshlig'i bilan tennis **o'ynaydi**.

sentences.text: We**'re having** lunch at the moment — call me after two.
sentences.translation: Hozir **tushlik qilyapmiz** — soat ikkidan keyin qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Tomorrow we**'re having** lunch with our friends from Oxford.
sentences.translation: Ertaga oksfordlik do'stlarimiz bilan **tushlik qilamiz**.

sentences.text: Madina **is driving** to work, so she isn't answering her phone.
sentences.translation: Madina ishga **mashinada ketyapti**, shuning uchun telefonga javob bermayapti.

sentences.text: Next Sunday Madina **is driving** her parents to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yakshanba Madina ota-onasini Farg'onaga mashinada **olib boradi**.

sentences.text: What **are** you **doing**? — I**'m packing** my suitcase.
sentences.translation: Nima **qilyapsiz**? — Chamadonimni **yig'yapman**.

sentences.text: Why are you packing? — I**'m flying** to Istanbul early tomorrow morning!
sentences.translation: Nega chamadon yig'yapsiz? — Ertaga erta tongda Istanbulga **uchib ketyapman**!

examples.title: Timetables: the train **leaves** at 7.30
examples.description: Jadval, dastur, ish vaqti bo'yicha kelajak — Present Simple: The train **leaves** ..., The film **starts** .... O'zbekchada ham «-adi»: «jo'naydi», «boshlanadi».

sentences.text: Our train to Samarkand **leaves** at 7.30 tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga poyezdimiz ertaga ertalab soat 7:30 da **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: The film **starts** at 8.15, so we need to leave at half past seven.
sentences.translation: Film soat 8:15 da **boshlanadi**, shuning uchun yetti yarimda chiqishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: What time **does** the museum **open** on Sunday?
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni muzey soat nechada **ochiladi**?

sentences.text: The new school year **begins** on 2 September.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'quv yili 2-sentabrda **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: My flight **lands** in London at ten past six in the evening.
sentences.translation: Samolyotim Londonga kechqurun oltidan o'n daqiqa o'tganda **qo'nadi**.

sentences.text: The English course **finishes** next Friday, and then there's an exam.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili kursi kelasi juma kuni **tugaydi**, keyin imtihon bor.

sentences.text: When **does** the concert **end**? — Around eleven.
sentences.translation: Konsert qachon **tugaydi**? — Soat o'n birlarda.

sentences.text: Hurry up! The last bus **goes** in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Shoshiling! Oxirgi avtobus o'n daqiqadan keyin **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: In England the football season **starts** in August and **ends** in May.
sentences.translation: Angliyada futbol mavsumi avgustda **boshlanib**, mayda **tugaydi**.

sentences.text: Our plane **doesn't leave** until midnight, so we've got time for dinner.
sentences.translation: Samolyotimiz yarim tungacha **uchmaydi**, shuning uchun kechki ovqatga vaqtimiz bor.

examples.title: **I'm leaving** tomorrow — the bus **leaves** at seven
examples.description: Ikki zamon birga: odamning rejasi — Present Continuous (I**'m going** to Bukhara), jadval — Present Simple (the bus **leaves** at seven).

sentences.text: **I'm going** to Bukhara on Friday, and my bus **leaves** at seven in the morning.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Buxoroga **ketyapman**, avtobusim ertalab soat yettida **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: We**'re watching** the new comedy tonight; it **starts** at nine.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun yangi komediyani **ko'ramiz**, u soat to'qqizda **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is joining** an English course, and the first lesson **begins** at six on Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Aziz ingliz tili kursiga **yozilyapti**, birinchi dars seshanba kuni soat oltida **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: What time **does** your plane **land**? — At 4.40. My brother **is meeting** me at the airport.
sentences.translation: Samolyotingiz soat nechada **qo'nadi**? — 4:40 da. Akam meni aeroportda **kutib oladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **is having** a job interview tomorrow, and it **begins** at half past nine.
sentences.translation: Ertaga Saraning ish bo'yicha **suhbati bor**, u soat to'qqiz yarimda **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: Quick! The shop **closes** in twenty minutes, and we**'re having** guests tonight!
sentences.translation: Tez bo'ling! Do'kon yigirma daqiqadan keyin **yopiladi**, bugun kechqurun esa bizga **mehmon keladi**!

sentences.text: The conference **finishes** on Thursday, but we**'re staying** in Oxford until Sunday.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya payshanba kuni **tugaydi**, lekin biz yakshanbagacha Oksfordda **qolamiz**.

sentences.text: Mum **is picking** us up from the station — our train **arrives** at five.
sentences.translation: Bizni vokzaldan **onam olib ketadi** — poyezdimiz soat beshda **keladi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **coming** to the match on Sunday? It **starts** at three.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kungi o'yinga **kelyapsizmi**? U soat uchda **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: Madina **isn't coming** with us, because her shift at the hospital **begins** at six.
sentences.translation: Madina biz bilan **kelmaydi**, chunki uning shifoxonadagi smenasi soat oltida **boshlanadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: are you free on Saturday?
examples.description: Dialog: ikki do'st dam olish kunlari rejasini kelishib oladi. Present Continuous — rejalar, Present Simple — jadval va ish vaqti.

sentences.text: — Hi, Tom! What **are** you **doing** on Saturday?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Tom! Shanba kuni nima **qilyapsan**?

sentences.text: — In the morning **I'm helping** my dad in the garden. Why?
sentences.translation: — Ertalab dadamga bog'da **yordam beraman**. Nimaydi?

sentences.text: — Emma and I **are going** to the new art gallery in the afternoon.
sentences.translation: — Emma ikkalamiz tushdan keyin yangi san'at galereyasiga **boramiz**.

sentences.text: — Sounds good! What time **does** it **open**?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r-ku! U soat nechada **ochiladi**?

sentences.text: — It **opens** at ten, but we**'re meeting** outside at two.
sentences.translation: — Soat o'nda **ochiladi**, lekin biz soat ikkida eshik oldida **uchrashamiz**.

sentences.text: — Perfect. **I'm not doing** anything after lunch.
sentences.translation: — Juda yaxshi. Tushlikdan keyin hech qanday **ishim yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Great! And in the evening **we're having** dinner at Aziz's place.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Kechqurun esa Aziznikida **ovqatlanamiz**.

sentences.text: — **Is** he **cooking** his famous plov again?
sentences.translation: — U yana mashhur palovini **damlaydimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, he is! His parents **are bringing** fresh vegetables from the village.
sentences.translation: — Ha! Ota-onasi qishloqdan yangi sabzavot **olib kelishyapti**.

sentences.text: — Then **I'm coming** too! What time **does** the last bus **leave**?
sentences.translation: — Unda men ham **boraman**! Oxirgi avtobus soat nechada **jo'naydi**?

examples.title: Mixed practice: plans for next week
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kelishilgan rejalar (Present Continuous) va jadvallar (Present Simple) — darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda.

sentences.text: On Monday morning **I'm having** an eye test at the clinic.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni ertalab klinikada **ko'zimni tekshirtiraman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod and Madina **are flying** to Istanbul on Tuesday, and their plane **takes** off at 6 a.m.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va Madina seshanba kuni Istanbulga **uchishadi**, samolyotlari ertalab soat oltida **ko'tariladi**.

sentences.text: **Is** your sister **coming** to the concert on Wednesday? — No, she's working late.
sentences.translation: Singlingiz chorshanba kungi konsertga **keladimi**? — Yo'q, kechgacha ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The concert **begins** at seven, but the doors **open** at half past six.
sentences.translation: Konsert soat yettida **boshlanadi**, lekin eshiklar olti yarimda **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: We **aren't cooking** on Thursday — we**'re eating** out with our neighbours.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni ovqat **pishirmaymiz** — qo'shnilarimiz bilan tashqarida **ovqatlanamiz**.

sentences.text: What time **does** your yoga class **finish** on Friday?
sentences.translation: Juma kuni yoga mashg'ulotingiz soat nechada **tugaydi**?

sentences.text: On Saturday Emma's parents **are celebrating** their 30th wedding anniversary.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni Emmaning ota-onasi to'ylarining 30 yilligini **nishonlashadi**.

sentences.text: Who **is** Aziz **inviting** to his birthday party next week?
sentences.translation: Aziz kelasi haftadagi tug'ilgan kuniga kimlarni **taklif qilyapti**?

sentences.text: Sorry, Tom, **I'm working** the night shift on Friday — what about Saturday?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Tom, juma kuni tungi smenada **ishlayman** — shanba-chi?

sentences.text: The museum **closes** at five, so we**'re visiting** it in the morning before lunch.
sentences.translation: Muzey soat beshda **yopiladi**, shuning uchun unga ertalab, tushlikdan oldin **boramiz**.
